citations.quote: Added a Prometheus rule plus a dashboard panel, and added the saturation metric to the payments service SLO review.
Instrumented the settlement pipeline with OpenTelemetry spans so we can attribute latency between our code and the PSP.

rationale: The evidence shows real observability work (a pool-saturation alert and dashboard panel, plus OpenTelemetry tracing of the settlement path), but none of the retrieved documents give incident counts or show a 90% reduction, so the magnitude is not supported.
